scan_result.description:
No new IQOS devices were found after scanning for {scan_seconds} seconds. Already configured IQOS devices are shown below for diagnostics, but are hidden from the add-device list.

Nearby connectable Bluetooth devices seen:

{nearby_devices}

If the list is empty, the Bluetooth proxy is not seeing nearby connectable BLE advertisements. Move the IQOS closer to the proxy, make sure `bluetooth_proxy.active: true` is enabled, then search again.

If other devices appear but the new IQOS does not, restart the new IQOS and keep it awake/connectable while searching. If you recognize the new IQOS in the nearby list, choose **Select a nearby Bluetooth device**.

Pairing guide:

ILUMA / ILUMA i / ILUMA ONE: turn the device on by holding ON/OFF for about 4 seconds, then release. Wait for the lights to turn on slowly or pulse.

If it still does not appear, reset Bluetooth advertising: press the device button twice quickly, then press it a third time and hold until the LEDs pulse. Keep the IQOS close to the Bluetooth proxy and start Search again immediately.

Do not connect the IQOS from phone or computer Bluetooth Settings before adding it here. If it was paired before, remove/forget old IQOS pairings from nearby phones and computers, toggle Bluetooth off/on on those devices, then retry Home Assistant search.

The IQOS App/WebApp is not required for this integration. If you use it only to test whether the IQOS can enter Bluetooth setup mode, start Add device / Connect device there, but do not finish pairing from the phone's Bluetooth Settings. On iPhone, the IQOS WebApp may need a Web Bluetooth browser such as Bluefy in countries where Safari/Chrome cannot use Web Bluetooth.

Older IQOS models with a Bluetooth button: press the Bluetooth button for about 3 seconds until the Bluetooth status light blinks.
scan_result.title: No new IQOS devices found

pairing_guide.description:
Start with **Search Bluetooth devices**. Home Assistant will scan through your Bluetooth adapter or ESPHome Bluetooth Proxy only after you press Search.

Pairing guide:

ILUMA / ILUMA i / ILUMA ONE: turn the device on by holding ON/OFF for about 4 seconds, then release. Wait for the lights to turn on slowly or pulse.

If it still does not appear, reset Bluetooth advertising: press the device button twice quickly, then press it a third time and hold until the LEDs pulse. Keep the IQOS close to the Bluetooth proxy and start Search again immediately.

Do not connect the IQOS from phone or computer Bluetooth Settings before adding it here. If it was paired before, remove/forget old IQOS pairings from nearby phones and computers, toggle Bluetooth off/on on those devices, then retry Home Assistant search.

The IQOS App/WebApp is not required for this integration. If you use it only to test whether the IQOS can enter Bluetooth setup mode, start Add device / Connect device there, but do not finish pairing from the phone's Bluetooth Settings. On iPhone, the IQOS WebApp may need a Web Bluetooth browser such as Bluefy in countries where Safari/Chrome cannot use Web Bluetooth.

Older IQOS models with a Bluetooth button: press the Bluetooth button for about 3 seconds until the Bluetooth status light blinks.

Keep only one IQOS in pairing/connectable mode while adding it.
pairing_guide.title: Set up IQOS

bluetooth_unavailable.description:
Home Assistant does not currently have a connectable Bluetooth scanner available. IQOS needs an active BLE/GATT connection, so a passive-only Bluetooth proxy is not enough.

Check this first:

1. Your ESPHome Bluetooth Proxy is online in Home Assistant.
2. The proxy YAML has `bluetooth_proxy.active: true`.
3. The Bluetooth integration shows the proxy under **Settings > Devices & services > Bluetooth**.
4. Restart the ESPHome proxy and Home Assistant if the proxy was just added.

After fixing Bluetooth, choose **Check Bluetooth again**. You can still enter a Bluetooth address manually, but the integration will not connect until a connectable Bluetooth proxy is available.
bluetooth_unavailable.title: Bluetooth proxy not ready
